title: Constrained decoder instrumentation and schema-assertor playtest
creator: Ava Patel
description: Build an observability-first test harness and runtime instrumentation layer for constrained-decoder (JSON mode) behavior. The goal is to capture per-field emit metrics, partial-stream recovery paths, and schema-assertor outcomes so we can (1) detect regressions across model and kernel variants, (2) measure how often constrained decoding resorts to fallbacks, and (3) validate that recovery strategies maintain schema adherence for downstream tools calling and structured-output consumers.
implementation_notes: We will add a lightweight middleware in the streaming pipeline that tags token spans with schema field mapping and emits event batches to the Console telemetry endpoint. The middleware intentionally minimizes blocking work on the hot path: sampling rules capture 1% of high-QPS routes and 100% of canary traffic. For deterministic unit tests we run with a synthetic model harness. Trade-offs: adding tagging increases per-token metadata but keeps payload small (field_id:int, emit_phase:enum). If high cardinality fields appear, we fallback to hashed buckets to avoid metric explosion.
test_plan: Create unit harness that replays 10k partial-stream transcripts covering common noise classes (truncation, interleaved toolcall tokens, malformed punctuation)
Run fuzz campaign that mixes soft schema relaxations and hard refuses to assert fallback modes; measure pass/fail against canonical schema
Canary: route 5% of streaming requests for runtime-1.22 to assertor with passive mode (log-only) and compare with control for latency regression
Active canary: enable assertor gating for 0.5% of traffic with automatic fallback to tolerant parser if strict assertor fails, monitor error budget and SLOs
Regression suite: nightly job that compares assertor metrics across model variants and kernel selections and produces a compatibility report
acceptance_criteria: Assertor produces per-field metrics: emit_count, partial_recovery_count, fallback_count, median_extra_latency_ms
No P50 latency regression > 8ms on sampled canary traffic (metric bucketed by route and model)
Regression job flags any schema adherence drop >= 2% vs baseline within 24 hours
Playbook documents when to toggle strict mode and how to interpret assertor telemetry
PR with runtime changes merged and a Console dashboard published for the assertor metrics

risks_and_mitigations: Metric cardinality growth - mitigated by hashed buckets and per-customer sampling controls
Latency impact under load - mitigated by sampling and offloading heavy aggregation to background workers
False positives in strict mode - mitigated by passive canary and a staged rollout plan with rollback commands
Toolchain compatibility (tool calls interleaved with JSON) - mitigation: augment assertor to mark toolcall token spans and treat them as recoverable interruptions
rollout_plan: 1) Deploy assertor middleware behind feature flag in runtime-1.22 to staging; 2) Enable passive telemetry on 5% of production routes for 72 hours; 3) If metrics stable, enable active gating on 0.5% traffic with tolerant fallback; 4) Gradually increase active gating while monitoring error budget and schema adherence metrics; 5) Promote to default strict mode for selected low-risk routes in runtime-1.22. Rollback: flip feature flag and flush sampled buffers.
follow_up_tasks: Instrument SDKs to surface assertor diagnostic headers for downstream integrations
Add end-to-end eval that includes on-prem / Private deployments to validate assertor behavior in air-gapped environments
Coordinate with Customer Success for early adopters willing to run strict mode and provide labeled transcripts
notes: This playtest focuses on observability-first approach rather than immediately enforcing strict schema failures on production traffic. The assertor is intended to inform safe rollout of constrained-decoder policies and to provide concrete telemetry for Optimize recommendations.
legal_and_compliance: No new PII capture. Telemetry events sampled and hashed to avoid storing raw user content. Compliance review not required for sampling defaults, but will run review if customer requests full traffic capture.
estimated_impact: Expected to reduce schema-related downstream errors by 30% on routes that adopt the assertor within 3 months and to provide signals for Optimize to recommend quantization/model variants with better schema fidelity.
